text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Two Maputo Development Corridor agreements will be signed next Monday in the Mozambican capital. One involves construction of a toll road between Maputo and the South African town of Witbank, the other concerns passenger and freight traffic. South Africa's Vice-President Thabo Mbeki and Transport Minister Mac Maharaj will be in Maputo for the ceremony.
- Work has begun on rehabilitation of the Maragra sugar mill near Maputo with the aim of reaching production of at least 1,000 tonnes annually within five years.
